evidence.sourceTitle: Czech energy innovators in the spotlight: Delta Green secures €2.2 million from Tilia Impact Ventures, Credo Ventures and Purple Ventures
evidence.excerpt: Delta Green says it finalized the investment with three VC funds, including Purple Ventures.
Official website describes a venture capital fund investing in CEE+ purpose-driven technology startups at pre-seed and seed, with €250k–€400k initial tickets and later follow-ons.
